APPROVED ADDITION (rat). Native validated via miRTarBase (rat is the 3rd-strongest species); predicted via miRDB v6.0 + TargetScan v8 conserved sites. DIANA-TarBase v9 (validated + CLIP) covers 24 species resource-wide but the prototype fetcher ingests hsa/mmu ONLY -> production must verify rat is in the v9 TSV set and extend the fetcher (then DIANA also feeds rat HIGH + MEDIUM).

APPROVED ADDITION (macaque). PREDICTED (predicted-dominant): substantive evidence is the TargetScan v8 PREDICTED LOW band (293 miRNAs). DIANA-TarBase v9 genuinely covers 24 species, but for MACAQUE its VOLUME is EXACTLY ONE validated MTI (mml-miR-125b-5p->ANGPT2, a Luciferase Reporter Assay) — that lone interaction is MARKED into the HIGH band (HIGH=1 MTI), NOT presented as broad validation; MEDIUM is empty. No miRTarBase per-species file, NOT shipped by miRDB v6.0 (5 species: hsa/mmu/rat/dog/chicken) - so those two contribute nothing for macaque. Restored as a production organism (no longer a removal).
